Name: Purchase Movie Theater Concessions
Author: Shreedle
Description:
[b][size=5]MOD HAS BEEN UPDATED FOR SDV 1.6+![/size][/b]

[b][u]List of All Changes Since 2.1.0:
[/u][/b]-Now compatible with SDV 1.6+
-Removed dependencies on JSON Assets and ShopTileFramework. Only Content Patcher is required now.[b][u]
[/u][/b]-Translation capabilities (i18n) has been added. Feel free to create translation files!
-The vendor is no longer animated as I removed the .tmx map for my sanity since I couldn't get it working.
-Vendor's shop text is slightly altered.
-Several item properties (buffs, etc.) were changed in an attempt to balance. Let me know if any seem unbalanced.
-Item prices in the Movie Theater are now the same as the original Concessions prices.
-Item images are now pulled directly from the game files. This means image retextures such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19226]Kedi's Movie Concession Retextures[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17483]Letteas Concession Snack Icons[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30623]Bunny's Purple Concessions[/url] are now compatible.[b][u]

What this mod does:[/u][/b]
Creates a new shop in the Movie Theater that allows you to purchase for yourself one of each concession item every time you go. This should work in both a Community Center game and a Joja Member game.[u]
[/u]
Also, every Friday and Sunday, the Traveling Merchant will randomly offer one concession item for sale at a fixed price.

JojaCorn is not available for purchase at the Movie Theater in a Community Center game, only in a Joja Member game. However, the Traveling Merchant may still have it rotate into her stock.

Concession items may be eaten to restore Energy and Health, and some even give temporary stat boosts!

Concession items can be gifted to villagers; all of them have the appropriate Loves, Likes, and Dislikes. None are Neutrals or Hates. At the moment, [b]vanilla and SVE NPCs should be supported.[/b] Other NPC compatibilities can be added per request.

The names of some items can be toggled in the Config due to other popular mods adding different items with the same name:
-Chocolate Popcorn <-> Choco Popcorn
-Cotton Candy <-> Candy Floss
-Ice Cream Sandwich <-> Vanilla Cream Sandwich
-Jasmine Tea <-> Blossom Tea
-Joja Cola <-> Joja Cola XL
-Popcorn <-> Classic Popcorn
-Truffle Popcorn <-> Gourmet Popcorn
